recentItems.title: Indonesians reportedly fought for Russia in Ukraine war
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Read more about this: https://sc.mp/62f8o

Indonesia is investigating reports that eight of its citizens who applied for civilian jobs were instead recruited to fight for Russia against Ukraine. Indonesia’s Coordinating Minister for Legal, Human Rights, Immigration and Corrections, Yusril Ihza Mahendra, said authorities are checking the identities and hiring processes of the individuals, who were allegedly lured by promises of high-paying, non-combat roles as well as fast-tracked Russian citizenship.

recentItems.title: Beauty consultant arrested for alleged aggressive sales tactics
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Hong Kong customs officers have arrested a woman on suspicion of using aggressive tactics to sell skincare products at a local beauty chain formerly operating under the Opatra London brand. The arrest of the 22-year-old beauty consultant brings the number of people apprehended in the case to three, after two managers linked to the brand were detained over similar tactics last month. 

This video updates a previous version to correct misleading footage.

recentItems.title: Over 1,700 made ill by food from Indonesia’s free meal scheme
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Indonesia’s US$12.94 billion free school meals programme has sickened another 1,700 students and teachers across four locations. On Wednesday, more than 750 students and teachers were reported to have suffered from diarrhoea and vomiting after consuming food from the meals scheme. Another 950 people reportedly fell ill in three separate locations on Tuesday and Wednesday.

recentItems.title: Hong Kong’s first robot-run convenience stores
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Beijing-based company Galbot has launched its first humanoid robot-operated convenience stores in Hong Kong. The venues include two outdoor shops in Hung Hom and Wan Chai and an indoor store at Kai Tak. SCMP reporter Llewellyn Cheung got a first-hand look at the store to see what the fully automated shopping experience was like.

recentItems.title: Funerals and DNA tests in Nepal a week after disaster
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

Families continue to perform last rites for victims who were swept away by last week’s flash floods in Nepal. At least 1,200 people have been confirmed dead following the disaster while more than 4,000 others have been reported missing. Authorities have started collecting DNA samples from survivors to help identify flood victims.

recentItems.title: Air China aircraft grounded in New York after refuelling mishap
recentItems.description:
Subscribe to our YouTube channel for free here: https://sc.mp/subscribe-youtube

A Boeing 747-8 operated by Air China was grounded at New York’s John F. Kennedy International Airport after a fuel truck drove away while refuelling. The incident early Monday reportedly damaged the aircraft’s fuel ports and caused a fuel spill on the tarmac. The Chinese flag carrier’s Beijing-bound flight was cancelled, leaving passengers stranded at the gate.
